summary: Iteration 8 (Faz 8) testing of NexusHesap: production work orders (iş emirleri) backend + /atolye shop-floor UI + iteration-7 fix verifications. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py — 19/21 passed. Verified PUT /production/recipes/rec_01 persists steps; POST /production/orders generates 2 work orders (step1 ready / step2 waiting) with step_count, station, unit, planned_quantity; GET /production/work-orders/stations lists 'Montaj Hattı 1' + 'QC'; start wo1 (operator Ali) -> in_progress + production order in_production + elapsed_min; starting waiting wo2 -> 400; pause -> paused + paused_at (2nd pause -> 400); resume -> in_progress with paused_seconds accumulated (>=1s) and paused_at cleared; PUT /work-orders/{id}/assign persists assigned_to/assigned_name; finish wo1 (produced 2) -> done + wo2 becomes ready, order_completed absent; re-finishing a done wo -> 400; finish last step -> order_completed true, production order completed, completed_quantity 2, finished stock +2 and all 3 raw materials decreased; generate-work-orders idempotent (count stays 2); status/station filters and 404s for unknown ids. Iteration-7 fixes: POST /products without barcode auto-generates (fixed); complete on a 'planned' order -> 400 'Önce üretimi başlatın (Başlat).'; complete without update_cost keeps purchase_price and adds stock; PUT /api/invoices/{approved} {notes,items} -> 400 while notes-only -> 200. Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): /atolye full flow verified (page render, no-operator warning, operator options from employees, localStorage persistence of operator+station across reload, wo-card/wo-start/wo-pause/wo-resume/wo-finish, elapsed 'dk geçti', finish modal produced/scrap/notes + toast 'Montaj tamamlandı. Sıradaki adım: Kalite Kontrol (QC).', step-2 card becomes Hazır, station filter, kiosk fixed-overlay toggle, toggle-done shows finished cards); /production (po-steps-<code> 'Adım 1/2 • Kalite Kontrol', po-complete only on in_production rows, planned rows show Başlat+cancel, recipe-modal recipe-add-step + step name/station inputs, Escape closes recipe-modal & production-order-modal, goto-shopfloor-btn navigates to /atolye); /contacts detail (installments tab with summary + 2 groups + Tahsil Et/Öde buttons after fixing a crash — see below, invoice right-click context menu with ctx-issued-info, Escape closes installment-plan-modal & statement-print-modal with no ghost overlay); /projects (sent+approval-pending quote stays in default Teklifler view with 'Onay bekliyor' badge, tab counter == visible rows, approval modal e-mail channel unchecked by default, Escape closes it); /invoices action column uniform (6 slots / 220px on all rows); /stock has no '+ Kategori' button and category buttons filter (9 -> 2 rows). All test data created was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Iteration-7 fix NOT applied: models.py Recipe still declares `code: str` (required), so posting a recipe without 'code' returns 422 and the server-side auto-code fallback stays dead code. Product.barcode was fixed, Recipe.code was not.
Raw Mongo `_id` is still returned next to `id` in every payload including /production/work-orders (pre-existing since iteration 6).

Calls complete_production_order with update_cost=True hard-coded, so finishing the last work order silently overwrites the finished product's purchase_price with the recipe unit cost (prod_01 850 -> 670 during this run). Contradicts the iteration-7 decision to make update_cost opt-in; make it configurable/audited.

produced_qty/scrap_qty are not validated against planned_quantity (finishing with produced 999 is accepted; complete_production_order clamps with min(produced, remaining) so the extra is silently dropped and scrap is never reconciled with material consumption).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (found & patched by tester): the new installments useEffect referenced `c` (dependency `[tab, c.id]` + `c.company_id`) while `const { contact: c } = data` is destructured ~50 lines later, causing 'ReferenceError: Cannot access c before initialization' on every render — the whole cari detail panel (all tabs, terms/statement/installments/context-menu features) crashed with the red runtime overlay. Patched to use data?.contact / contactId; please review the final shape.
React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' logged for the operator <option> (same pre-existing pattern as PaymentTargetSelect).

issues: Escape closes the inner print preview but not the statement modal itself (only X) — inconsistent with the other Faz 7/8 modals that now use useEscape

Kiosk overlay hides the app sidebar/header as intended, but there is no visible exit affordance other than the 'Çık' button at the top-right; on a small tablet the button scrolls out of view with many cards
Active company still shows 'MATEK DEKORASYON' while every list (incl. work orders) queries comp_nexus_main_01 (pre-existing from iterations 6-7)

action_items: models.py: make Recipe.code Optional[str] = '' — POST /api/production/recipes without code still returns 422 (iteration-7 action item not done).
Review/keep the tester's ContactDetailPanel fix (TDZ crash on `c`) and add a lint rule / smoke test so the cari detail panel is exercised after every change.
finish_work_order: stop hard-coding update_cost=True (it rewrites the product's purchase_price), and validate produced_qty/scrap_qty against planned_quantity/remaining instead of silently clamping.
Exclude Mongo `_id` in clean_doc() (still leaking in every response, incl. work orders).
Optional: add useEscape to the statement modal in ContactsPage and render option labels as plain text (no <span> child) in ShopFloorPage/PaymentTargetSelect.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactDetailPanel.jsx declares hooks/handlers that reference the destructured `c` before line 96 — several other handlers (openPay, sendWa, openEditPay) only work because they run after render; move `const { contact: c } = data` above all handlers or pass contactId explicitly.
server.py is 3504 lines; the production/work-order block (~250 lines) is a natural router extraction.

_generate_work_orders sorts recipe steps by 'no' but renumbers step_no by index, so a recipe with duplicate/missing 'no' values silently reorders work orders — validate step numbering when saving the recipe.

finish_work_order swallows HTTPException from complete_production_order into a message string; the work order is already marked done, so a stock failure leaves the order permanently out of sync with no retry path.
ShopFloorPage polls every 15s with 3 parallel requests and no cancellation; on a tablet left open this is ~720 requests/hour — consider a single aggregated endpoint or visibility-aware polling.

rca_of_the_issue: ContactDetailPanel crash: the Faz 8 installments feature added `const loadInsts = () => ...c.company_id...` and `useEffect(..., [tab, c.id])` at line 46-47, but `c` comes from `const { contact: c } = data` at line 96 (after the `if (!data) return` guard). The dependency array is evaluated during render, so React hit the const's temporal-dead-zone and threw ReferenceError before any JSX rendered, killing the entire panel for every contact (reproduce: open /contacts?contact_id=cnt_01 on the unpatched build). Mitigation applied: read company_id from data?.contact and use contactId in the deps.
